original_test_intent: Verify that the Form Factor enum in every Type 17 record matches the physical memory-device/socket design for its locator and population state, uses only values valid for the applicable SMBIOS version, and remains semantically stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version, bind each raw Form Factor enum to handle/locator/size/type identity, compare the approved socket/module form factor including empty-slot policy and optional trusted module inventory, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the socket/module form-factor map and reboot plan. This review does not require opening the chassis or manipulating DIMMs.
required_inputs: Expected Form Factor enum per locator/socket or device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and accepted enumeration values
Policy for empty slots and Other/Unknown/vendor-defined values
Validated parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and approved inventory sources; do not install, remove or reseat memory.
Preserve raw enum and decode it under the recorded SMBIOS version.
Evaluate Form Factor with locator, Size/population and Memory Type; do not accept a global label detached from record identity.
Do not infer physical form factor from capacity or OS-visible memory alone.
Stop on invalid enum, mapping ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each raw Form Factor, validate version, compare per-locator socket/module design and pre/post reboot semantic state.
Do not perform physical inspection, change hardware or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the per-locator physical form-factor and empty/special-value policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict; request physical inspection only as separate corroboration if inventory remains disputed.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Form Factor line is relevant, but grep -A1 omits its Type 17 handle/locator, raw enum, version and population context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 data; report handle, locator, Size/population, Memory Type, raw/decoded Form Factor, version-validity and baseline result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Form Factor scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing and physical memory actions are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode raw Form Factor per complete Type 17 identity, check enumeration validity for the declared SMBIOS version, compare the approved socket/module design and repeat the semantic map after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 records for discrete, soldered and represented empty memory-device locations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and optional SPD inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Form Factor enumeration and authoritative board/module mechanical design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum/version, per-locator identity and population-aware topology comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects invalid/reserved enums, form factors assigned to wrong sockets, empty-slot policy violations and decoded-label drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-locator form-factor map and special-value policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SPD may identify module properties but does not by itself establish firmware's required socket-level encoding for empty locations.

project_override_considerations: A project may include multiple form factors or soldered devices, but expected values must be keyed to stable locators/classes; a single platform-wide DIMM assumption cannot replace the board map.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-locator form-factor and enum/version policy
Per-record locator/population/type, raw and decoded Form Factor and version-validity result
Optional trusted module/SPD correlation with explicit mapping
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic form-factor diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Form Factor field has clear enum semantics; the awkward item wording does not conflict with the Type 17 target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Enum decoding and topology comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum/version validation, complete identity and population-aware form-factor mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains per-locator safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps optional physical inspection separate from the automatable firmware-metadata core and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible DIMM label from passing when it is reserved for the SMBIOS version, associated with another socket or inconsistent with that record's population/type.
independent_technical_reasoning: Form Factor is a finite versioned enum attached to enumerable Type 17 identities; comparison to an approved topology is a deterministic software task.
